svg.title: Coastal lighthouse — Strandviti
svg.desc: A tall tapering coastal lighthouse rises from a rocky base and has a glazed lantern at its top.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Sectors and Nature","subject":"fisheries-lighthouse","label_en":"Coastal lighthouse","label_is":"Strandviti","section":"03","category_en":"Fisheries services, ports and cold logistics","category_is":"Þjónusta við sjávarútveg, hafnir og kælikeðja","batch":2,"tags":["fisheries","navigation"],"description":"A tall tapering coastal lighthouse rises from a rocky base and has a glazed lantern at its top.","design_note":"The taller tapering tower, lower door and broad coastal base differentiate it from the compact harbour beacon.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
